clip_separation_note: the two clip centers are REJECTION-SAMPLED to be >= 2 in apart: a clip's mounting taps occupy the holes around it, so closer clips would fight for the same holes. The loader re-validates this.

operator_frame.origin: same real tabletop origin as marker_d2/square_d2
operator_frame.rope: spans the full y-axis at x=rope_x; only translates along x
operator_frame.yaw: z rotation, 0 means clip long axis points +forward (+x)

rope_clip_collision_note: the rope spans all y at rope_x; a clip whose x is near rope_x sits on the rope line. R0 does NOT enforce a min |rope_x - clip_x| clearance (clips are routing targets the rope is led into); see the clearance stats printed at build time.

clip_left.description: clip sampled jointly with the rope, snapped to a 0.5-offset 1-inch dot grid; operator places the clip at the snapped (x, y) with the stated orientation

clip_right.description: clip sampled jointly with the rope, snapped to a 0.5-offset 1-inch dot grid; operator places the clip at the snapped (x, y) with the stated orientation

baseline_uniform.space: joint rope + 2 clips (clip x/y snapped to grid, orient index snapped)

eval_heldout.note: downstream eval/heldout set; an INDEPENDENT Sobol stream (its own seed, not a continuation of mulligan_sobol) so eval starts are independent of training starts
eval_heldout.space: joint rope + 2 clips (clip x/y snapped to grid, orient index snapped)

mulligan_sobol.space: joint rope + 2 clips (clip x/y snapped to grid, orient index snapped)

ordering.method: greedy-NN multi-start + 2-opt + or-opt ILS (double-bridge), dummy-node open path
ordering.objective: per-clip pose change = 60 in-equivalents (re-mount) + euclidean inches; identical pose carries over free
ordering.note: Blind to arm labels (physical state only). Partial-prefix representativeness intentionally waived: training starts only after all 250 episodes are collected.
